spans.s:
mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं)
Following.
E.
अनु after, and अक्षि the eye.

mfn. (-न्वङ्-नूची-न्वक्)
Following.
E.
अनु after, अञ्च to go, and क्विन् aff.

m. (-यः)
1 Race, lineage, succession.
2 Connexion, acquaintance, intercourse.
3 The natural order or connexion of words in a sentence or stanza.
3 The logical connexion of cause and effect, or proposition and conclusion.
E.
अनु after, इण to go, and अच् aff.

m. (-ज्ञः)
A genealogist.
E.
अन्वय, and ज्ञ who knows.

mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि)
1 Following, agreeing with.
2 Belonging to race or family.
E.
अन्वय and इनि aff.

m. (-यः)
Race, lineage.
E.
अनु after, अव prefixed to इण to go, and अच् aff.

f. (-का)
A Śrāddha or funeral ceremony performed on the ninth day of the months Pauṣa, Māgha, Phālguna, or Āśvina. It is the maternal Śrāddha for those who preserve the sacred fire.
E.
अनु after, and अष्टका the eighth day.

ind.
Every day, daily.
E.
अनु, and अहन् a day.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Connecting, uniting.
E.
अनु, and आङ् before चि to collect, अच् aff.

f. (-घिः)
1 A bail or deposit to be delivered to a third person.
2 Repentance.
E.
अनु according to, and आधि a pledge.

n. (-यं)
Property presented after marriage to the wife by her husband's family.
E.
अनु subsequently, and आधेय to be taken or received.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Latitudinal.
E.
अनु, and आयतन breadth.

n. (-णं)
Mounting the funeral pile after or with the body of the husband.
E.
अनु, and आरोहण ascending.

n. (-नं)
1 An unctuous or cooling enema.
2

Service.
3

Regret, affliction.
4 A place where work is done, a manufactory, a house of industry.
E.
अनु before, आस to sit, and ल्युट् aff.

m. (-र्य्यः)
1 The monthly Śrāddha, or funeral repast in honour of the manes, held on the day of new moon; it should be, according to Menu, of meat eaten after the presentation of a piṇḍa or ball of rice.
2 The monthly obsequies performed during the first year after the death of a parent.
E.
अनु after, and आहार्य्य to be taken or eaten; from हृ with आङ् prefixed, and ण्यत् aff.

n. (-कं)
See the preceding.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Daily, diurnal.
E.
अन्वह daily, ठञ् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Deposited with a person to be delivered ultimately to another.
E.
अनु, and आहित placed.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Joined, connected with.
2 Having as an essential or inherent part, possessed of, possessing.
3 Connected as in grammar, or construction.
E.
अनु with, and इत gone, part. of इण; also अन्वीत.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Joined, connected with. See अन्वित.
E.
अन with, and ईत from ई to go.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Sought.
E.
अनु after, and इष desire, with the part. affix क्त.

fn. (-णा-णं)
1 Research, investigation of duty by reasoning.
2 Research, enquiry in general.
E.
अनु, इष to desire, and ल्यु aff. and in the fem. टाप्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Sought.
E.
the part. past. of इष, with अनु prefixed, and इ inserted before क्त.

mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि)
Seeking, inquiring after.
E.
अनु before, इष to wish, णिनि aff.

mfn. (-ष्टा-ष्ट्री-ष्टृ)
An enquirer, a searcher.
E.
अनु before इष, and तृच् affix of agency.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Of a good family, well born.
2 Orderly, according to order or arrangement.
E.
अन्वय race, ठक् aff.

f. (-की)
Logical philosophy, metaphysics.
E.
अनु according to, ईक्ष to see, ठक् aff.
